text:
maya: Anyone seeing the preemptible GPU pool in us-west1 stuck NotReady? CA isn't scaling up new nodes and several pods are Pending due to NoSchedule taints.

alex: Which pool/name? symptoms? kubelet logs?

maya: preemptible-gpu-pool. ~12 nodes NotReady. kubelet log excerpts show repeated driver handshake timeouts and device plugin crashloops: 
```
Nov 14 03:21:12 kubelet[1234]: E11014 03:21:12.123456 kubelet.go:123] device plugin registration timeout: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
Nov 14 03:21:12 kernel: nvidia: probe failed with error -5
```

ben: CA logs show scale-up suppressed: "scaleUpUnneeded" because cloud provider reports instance template unhealthy. Also see nodes show taint `node.kubernetes.io/unschedulable:NoSchedule` after kubelet flips NotReady.

infra-oncall: Tried restarting `nvidia-driver-daemon` and `nvidia-device-plugin` daemonsets. Rollout restart shows pods come up then crashback: CrashLoopBackOff with `grpc: connection closed`. Reboots of affected nodes temporarily fixed 2/12.

sam: Could be an AMI/kernel bump — we had an automated image bake yesterday in us-west1. If kernel modules don't match the driver build, module probe will fail. Short-term mitigation: cordon problematic nodes, spin up a cpu-only fallback pool for latency-sensitive workloads, and add a temporary scheduling exception for lower-tier models.

alex: Agree. Action plan: 1) cordon & drain failing nodes so CA can provision replacements; 2) rollback preemptible instance template to previous AMI; 3) disable preemptible autoheal loop while we validate image; 4) open cloud provider support ticket for probe errors. I'll start the rollback now.

maya: Cordoned nodes and started drains. `kubectl drain node/gpu-uw1-003 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` hung on kubelet NotReady for a couple of pods but eventually succeeded after node reboot.

ben: FYI CA observed repeated create/terminate cycles earlier — causing quota hits and delaying scale-up. Recommend temporarily increasing GPUS quota in the region to reduce backoff.

infra-oncall: I've opened INFRA-2147 and attached the driver logs and AMI diff. Also flagged with cloud provider support.

engbot: Deploybot: Started instance template rollback for `preemptible-gpu-pool` at 2100001489.

sam: If rollback succeeds, let's run a small canary (2 nodes) with `nvidia-smi` smoke check and device-plugin healthcheck before scaling to full capacity. Also add a short-lived readiness probe on device-plugin pod to avoid registering until driver is ready.

alex: Good call. I'll also patch the autoscaler config to ignore transient NotReady for 90s (was 30s) to reduce churn during next incident.

maya: Thanks — ping me when canary passes. :thumbsup:
